name: sos_signature
description: SOS signature verification per spec Section 18.3/18.4.1. Covers link-layer signature (silent drop on invalid) and origin signature (domain separation, canonical CBOR, replay protection).

vectors.name: sos_valid_signature_accept
vectors.description: SOS with valid Schnorr48 signature is accepted.

vectors.name: sos_missing_signature_drop
vectors.description: SOS without signature is silently dropped (no error response).

vectors.name: sos_invalid_signature_drop
vectors.description: SOS with invalid signature is silently dropped.

vectors.name: sos_truncated_signature_drop
vectors.description: SOS with truncated signature (< 48 bytes) is dropped.

vectors.name: sos_wrong_key_signature_drop
vectors.description: SOS signed with wrong key (not matching sender IID) is dropped.

vectors.name: sos_signature_covers_payload
vectors.description: Signature must cover entire SOS payload (type, severity, location, etc.).

vectors.name: sos_replay_same_signature_reject
vectors.description: Same SOS (identical payload+sig) replayed is rejected via replay window.

vectors.name: sos_unknown_pubkey_tofu
vectors.description: SOS from unknown sender: TOFU pins pubkey on first valid sig.

vectors.name: sos_silent_drop_rationale
vectors.description: Silent drop (no error response) prevents attacker enumeration.

expected.note: Attacker cannot probe which IIDs have valid keys

vectors.name: origin_domain_separation
vectors.description: Origin signature uses domain 'LICHEN-SOS-ORIGIN-v1' to prevent cross-protocol reuse.
vectors.note: Signature over SOS cannot be replayed as DAO origin signature

vectors.name: origin_transcript_format
vectors.description: Origin signature transcript: SHA-512(domain || ipv6 || seq || cbor)

vectors.name: canonical_cbor_key_order
vectors.description: CBOR canonical encoding sorts keys by length then lexicographically (RFC 8949 4.2.1).
vectors.note: 3-char keys before 4-char keys; within same length, lexicographic

vectors.name: origin_wire_format
vectors.description: Origin signature wire format: 8-byte big-endian seq + 48-byte Schnorr

vectors.name: origin_sequence_replay
vectors.description: Same origin sequence from same sender is rejected as replay

vectors.name: origin_sequence_rollback
vectors.description: Origin sequence less than last seen is rejected

vectors.name: wrong_domain_rejected
vectors.description: Signature computed with wrong domain string is invalid
